title: Apple Framework Definitions
description: All Apple framework definitions for AppleFrameworkRegistry

autoBridge.description: Whether types in this module are automatically ObjC-bridged

optionalFallback.description: Whether this module is in the broader Optional/Array element fallback set (superset of autoBridge)

unsupported.description: Whether this module is unsupported (SwiftUI, Combine, etc.)

concreteClassFallback.description: Whether this module ships concrete Swift classes whose names do not always match an ObjC class prefix (e.g., RealityFoundation.Entity, RealityKit.AnchorEntity). The @_cdecl-wrapper renderer uses this to recognise Optional<Class> on cross-module unresolved class names.

wrapperImportable.description: Whether the generator should emit `import <module>` into the wrapper Swift file when this module's types appear in the bound surface. Default false: opt in explicitly per module. Excluded by design for ambient/SPI modules that collide with bound-module type names (Network), unconditional imports (Foundation), umbrella source modules whose import is rewritten via compileImportModule (RealityFoundation -> RealityKit), and Swift system/marker modules (_Concurrency, ObjectiveC, Dispatch).

namespaceRemap.description: If set, this Swift module maps to a different .NET namespace (e.g., QuartzCore -> CoreAnimation)

compileImportModule.description: If set, the wrapper Swift file emits 'import <this>' instead of 'import <module>'. Used for Apple modules marked @_implementationOnly by their umbrella module (e.g., RealityFoundation -> RealityKit). Only the literal import line changes; type qualifications and the .NET namespace continue to use the logical module name.

objcPrefixes.description: ObjC class name prefixes associated with this framework (e.g., ['UI'] for UIKit)

platformUnavailable.description: Platforms where this module is entirely unavailable

knownModuleForElements.description: Whether this module is known for container element type resolution

valueTypes.description: Type names (without module prefix) that are value types and should NOT be ObjC-bridged

typeRemaps.description: Map of Swift type names (without module prefix) to fully-qualified .NET type names

excludeFromXml.description: Type names that must NOT be added to XML database files (e.g., NSUnderlineStyle)

netUnavailableTypes.description: Type names (without module prefix) that are auto-bridged in Swift but not present in the corresponding .NET assembly. Referencing them at C# emission time produces CS0234.

packageId.description: NuGet package ID for this module's binding package (e.g., 'SwiftBindings.Apple.RealityKit'). Used by apple-framework-mode auto-injection of cross-module dependency edges. Only set for modules that ship as standalone SwiftBindings.Apple.<Module> packages.
